description: I'm re-siding my house myself. The east wall is only half a metre from the fence on the property line, with my neighbour's house beyond it. I want to use vinyl siding on that wall to match the rest. The city says that wall needs metal or noncombustible siding. Can I get permission for vinyl?
known_facts: east wall 0.5 m from the property line

missing_info.why: Section A of the variance form

gold.departure: Combustible vinyl cladding on an exposing building face with a limiting distance under 0.6 m.

must_not_cite.why: the wall faces a neighbouring house, not a garage or accessory building on the same property

authoring.author: Batatis evaluation builder (Claude Opus 5.5)
authoring.notes: Written from the code database only; held-out judge set not consulted.
